slice_16b_selection.title: Add staging RG ActualCost budgets with ops notify thresholds (not anomaly detection)
slice_16b_selection.why_smallest: Complete live absence (budgets=[]), smallest ownership surface (Azure budget + action group only), no Staff API/Hermes runtime change, offline-verifiable from secret-free fixtures, builds on measured MTD costs. This is budget-threshold partial progress only — anomaly detection remains a separate absent control.
out_of_scope_for_16b: Cost anomaly detection (separate acceptance; not claimed by 16B)
acceptance_criteria: Azure Consumption budget exists on wh-staging-rg with amount >= measured MTD baseline and at least one notification threshold (e.g. 80% and 100%)
Azure Consumption budget exists on luna-sunset-staging-rg with the same properties
Action group used by budgets has a non-ARM ops receiver (email or webhook) — no secrets in git
Secret-free fixture + verifier prove budget names/scopes/thresholds without reading secret values
Real notification-delivery proof required (test notification received/delivered) — Enabled configuration alone fails
No Staff API, Hermes, DB schema, or guest/payment runtime behavior change in the 16B diff
16B must not claim anomaly-detection acceptance; anomaly remains separately absent
budget_notification_acceptance: Budget resources present on both staging RGs with explicit % thresholds
Ops receiver exists and a real notification delivery event is evidenced (not merely Enabled=true)
anomaly_detection_acceptance: Separate follow-on: Cost Management anomaly alert or equivalent with delivery proof — out of scope for 16B
